events.title: Kasai Super Fes
events.summary: Children can enjoy autumn-themed games, food trucks, and pony rides at this annual community plaza festival.

events.title: Harue Festival
events.summary: Children can enjoy music performances and interactive stamp rallies focused on welfare and community awareness.

events.title: Kyopura Puratto Autumn Festival
events.summary: Children can enjoy various game booths, food stalls with autumn flavors, futsal experiences, and a mini planetarium.

events.title: Recycle World in Tobu
events.venue: Tobu Kumin-kan Parking Lot and Surrounding Roads
events.summary: Enjoy a flea market, food stands, food drives, and local Komatsuna vegetable sales.

events.title: Youth Carnival
events.venue: Komatsugawa Elementary School yard and surrounding areas
events.summary: This lively neighborhood festival features portable shrines, food stalls, stage performances, and family-friendly activities.

events.title: Edogawa Volunteer Festival
events.summary: Volunteer groups showcase their activities with stage performances and a flea market.

events.title: Shinkawa Midori and Gochiso Market
events.summary: This event features local flower and vegetable sales along with a small petting zoo.
